tasks.short: Participate in professional organizations and continuing education.

steps.what: Sort continuing education offers from those organizations

loop.input: The society paper already filed for this nurse.
loop.output: A card with title, society, date, and one sentence copied from the abstract.
loop.check: The title, the society and the date appear in the paper, and the sentence is a contiguous quote from the abstract. The card adds no claim that quote does not contain.
loop.stop: The nurse keeps or drops the card after one pass. If the paper has no abstract sentence, no card is made.
loop.why_not_simpler: A keyword list cannot show which sentence states the skill.

steps.what: Read the kept paper to improve practice knowledge
Participate in professional organizations during the session
Judge which skills belong in this unit practice
Note the education hours on the attendance slip

tasks.design: A card in {DOCS} lists each new society paper already on file, with the title, the society, the date, and one sentence copied from the abstract. The nurse still reads the paper she keeps, still attends the session, still judges which skill to use, and still writes the hours on the slip. If the paper has no title or no abstract sentence, the card is not made and she sorts the pile as today.
tasks.previous_blocker: The useful sentence sits in a different place in each paper, so a fixed filter could not build an honest card.
tasks.enabler_now: A short loop can quote one abstract sentence and stop, and the nurse can reject the card.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing which skill this unit should change still depends on the patients in the beds that week.
tasks.human_edge: She decides which skill belongs on this unit. A card does not make that choice.

ambition.what: Which new society paper is worth reading before the next shift, while the issue is still current.

tasks.altitude: The week is still bedside care plus the session. The only shorter step is sorting the new papers when a quotable abstract exists.

reach.task: Collect the hours slip after the session.
reach.learn: The slip is still written by the nurse. There is no feed of course id, hours and date to post for her.

evidence.claim: A card that quotes an abstract does not replace reading the paper. Model knowledge.
The inspectorate says providers are legally responsible for careful use of generative AI, including risk, training and monitoring after updates.
Ambient recording of staff can be a works-council matter under WOR art. 27(1)(l). This design does not record the session.

assumptions: Focal boundary: this task is the critical care nurse sorting papers, reading the one she keeps, attending the session, judging the skill, and writing the hours slip. The society that writes the paper is outside this baseline.

The card uses fields already on the paper: title, society name, date, and one abstract sentence. Producer of those words is the professional body that published the paper. No separate capture step is added here.
If title or abstract sentence is missing, no card is made, s1 stays at today's full time, and the saving does not apply.
Reading, the session, the skill judgement, and the hours slip are not shortened. No course-completion feed is assumed, so the slip is not posted by a machine.
The session is not recorded, so no works-council consent for recording is required. Upkeep is the one hour below for filing a new issue onto the list.
unknowns: Whether society papers already sit in {DOCS} or only in the nurse's mailbox.
Whether the hospital expects a signed hours total, and who files it after the nurse writes the slip.
research_questions: What share of society papers on this unit have a title and an abstract sentence that can be quoted?

already_counted.description: Keep or drop each paper card.

incremental.description: Add a new society issue to the card list when it is filed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the sort of new papers is halved, and only when the paper has a title and a quotable abstract sentence. Reading, the session, the skill judgement and the hours slip stay at full time. One hour of list upkeep is already taken off. If most papers lack an abstract, the result is near the low end.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in development, review, or evaluation of nursing practice protocols.

steps.what: Gather current nursing practice protocols and the incidents

loop.input: The published protocol paragraph and the incident note that prompted the review.
loop.output: The stored paragraph beside one sentence copied from the incident note.
loop.check: The protocol sentence is the stored paragraph for that id, and the incident sentence is a contiguous quote. The pair adds no sentence that is not in those two texts.
loop.stop: The nurse confirms the pair or opens the binder. One pass. If either text is missing, no pair is shown.
loop.why_not_simpler: A link on ids alone does not show the sentence that conflicts.

steps.what: Draft wording for protocol development review

loop.input: The paired extract the nurse confirmed.
loop.output: A wording draft that marks old words and new words for one paragraph id.
loop.check: Every changed sentence names the paragraph id, marks the old words and the new words, and adds no clinical step that the paragraph and the incident quote do not already contain.
loop.stop: The nurse accepts, edits, or discards the draft after one pass.
loop.why_not_simpler: A blank comment box cannot tell which incident sentence conflicts with which paragraph.

steps.what: Participate in the evaluation of those practice protocols
Send her comments on that protocol version

tasks.design: On {DOCS} the stored protocol paragraph sits beside a quoted sentence from the incident note, and a draft changes only words that name that paragraph. She still evaluates the wording with the practice group and still sends her own comments. If the paragraph id or the incident text is missing, she hunts the binder and writes the draft herself, and that saving does not apply.
tasks.previous_blocker: The conflict is a sentence in a note, not a code, so a rule on paragraph id alone could not propose an honest change.
tasks.enabler_now: The paragraph and the note can be shown together, and a draft can be limited to marked word changes that she accepts or discards.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the change is safe for this unit is decided in the room, with the people who use the protocol.
tasks.human_edge: She argues for or against the change in the meeting. The draft does not publish the protocol.

ambition.what: Which protocol paragraph an incident actually conflicts with, before the review meeting rather than only in the room.

tasks.altitude: The meeting stays the week. Less time is spent finding the paragraph and marking a first wording when both texts already exist.

reach.task: Publish the protocol paragraph id and the paragraph text before a review starts.
reach.learn: Without that id and text, the nurse hunts the binder and the pair is not shown.

evidence.claim: A draft that must name a paragraph and mark old and new words can be checked by the nurse. A blank template cannot see which incident sentence conflicts. Model knowledge.
The inspectorate says providers are legally responsible for careful use of generative AI. The draft is checked by the nurse and does not publish the protocol.
Health data are a special category, and a decision based solely on automated processing needs a legal basis. The pair and the draft are not a decision about a patient.

assumptions: Focal boundary: the nurse gathers the texts, drafts wording, evaluates it in the meeting, and sends her comments. Publishing the protocol is the protocol owner's work and is not in this baseline.

Contract for the pair: paragraph id and paragraph text, produced by the protocol owner when the protocol was published. Incident note id and the note text, produced by the reporting nurse when the incident was written. That writing is a different task and is not zeroed here.
If paragraph id or incident text is missing, s1 and s2 stay at today's full time and the saving does not apply.
The meeting and the comment mail stay at full time. The draft is not filed as the new protocol. Upkeep is the two hours below when a new paragraph version is published.
unknowns: Whether current protocols already have stable paragraph ids.
Whether incident notes are in the same store as the protocol or only on paper.
research_questions: What share of protocol reviews on this unit start from a stored paragraph id and a stored incident note?

already_counted.description: Confirm or reject the paired extract.
Edit or discard the wording draft.
Evaluate the wording in the meeting.
Write and send the comment mail.

incremental.description: Retie a draft when the protocol owner publishes a new paragraph version.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the hunt for the paragraph and the first wording draft are halved, and only when paragraph id and incident text already exist. The meeting and the comment mail stay at full time. Two hours of upkeep are already taken off. If protocols are still unbound paper, the result is near the low end.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the patient problems before the care conference

loop.input: The problem list already stored on the patient record.
loop.output: A brief of problem id and the problem line as stored.
loop.check: Every brief line appears in the record, and the brief adds no problem that is not written there.
loop.stop: The nurse confirms the brief or reads the chart. One pass. If there is no stored line, no brief is shown.
loop.why_not_simpler: A list of problem ids without the line hides the free-text wording the conference needs.

steps.what: Invite people to these patient conferences
Coordinate the talk during those patient conferences
Write what the conference agreed for that patient

tasks.design: A brief on {OTHER} shows the stored problem id and the problem line already in the record before the conference. She still chooses who comes, still holds the conference, and still writes the agreed plan in her own words. If no stored line exists she reads the chart as today, family details are not taken from a directory, and the conference is not recorded.
tasks.previous_blocker: The problem line is often free text, so a list of codes did not show what the room needed to hear.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored line can be shown beside its id, and the nurse can reject a brief that adds a problem.
tasks.still_hard: What the family and the team agree still happens in the room, and she still writes that agreement.
tasks.human_edge: She hears the family and decides what the note should say. The brief does not write the note.

ambition.what: Whether a stored problem needs a conference this week, once the line is visible without a chart hunt.

tasks.altitude: The conference and the note stay. The chart hunt is shorter only when a problem line is already stored.

reach.task: Enter the problem id and the problem line on the record before the conference.
reach.learn: If that line is missing, the nurse reads the chart and the brief saving does not apply.

evidence.claim: Family contact details are often not a structured mailbox, so the invite is not posted by a machine. Model knowledge.
Health data are a special category, and a decision based solely on automated processing needs a legal basis. The brief displays stored lines and does not decide the plan.
The patient dossier is kept twenty years after the last change. The conference note the nurse writes is part of that dossier.
Annex III covers public eligibility for care and emergency triage. A conference brief is neither.
Ambient recording of staff can be a works-council matter under WOR art. 27(1)(l). The conference is not recorded.

assumptions: Focal boundary: the nurse reads the problems, invites people, holds the conference, and writes the note. The treating clinician's entry of the problem line is outside this baseline.

Contract for the brief: problem id and problem line, produced by the treating clinician who wrote them on the record. No other field is required. Family name, phone and mailbox are not in the contract, and the invite stays her work at full time.
If the problem line is missing, she reads the chart, s1 stays at today's full time, and the saving does not apply.

The invite, the conference and the note stay at full time. Nothing writes the clinical sentence. The conference is not recorded. Upkeep is the one hour below when a problem line is withdrawn and the brief must be cleared.
unknowns: Whether problem lines on this unit are stored as text or only inside a scanned note.
Who besides the nurse is allowed to read the brief.
research_questions: What share of conferences start with a problem line already stored as text on the record?

already_counted.description: Confirm the conference brief or go back to the chart.
Invite the people, including the family by phone or mail.

incremental.description: Clear a brief when a problem line is withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the chart read is halved, and only when a problem line is already stored. The invite, the conference and the note stay at full time. Family details are not taken from a directory. One hour of upkeep is already taken off. If lines are missing, the result is near the low end.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan, provide, or evaluate educational programs for staff and community members.

steps.what: Choose which educational programs nursing staff need
Draft the outline those educational programs will use

loop.input: The approved paragraph for the topic the nurse chose.
loop.output: An outline, each point tied to one paragraph.
loop.check: Each point quotes a paragraph of the approved protocol, or for a community session a paragraph of the approved public text, and adds no step that paragraph does not contain.
loop.stop: The nurse accepts the outline or rewrites it after one draft. If there is no approved paragraph, no outline is drafted.
loop.why_not_simpler: A standing slide deck stays wrong after the paragraph is revised.

steps.what: Provide that program to the interdisciplinary group
Evaluate community members after the health program
Mark which nursing staff attended the program

tasks.design: An outline in {DOCS} quotes the approved protocol paragraph, one point per paragraph, and adds no step that paragraph does not contain. For a community session the same check allows only a paragraph from a public text the hospital has already approved. She still chooses the topic, still gives the session, still judges whether people can do the skill, and still marks attendance herself, and the session is not recorded.
tasks.previous_blocker: The paragraph that allows a teaching point changes, so a stored slide deck drifted from the protocol.
tasks.enabler_now: A draft can be forced to quote the current paragraph, and the nurse can reject a point that adds a step.
tasks.still_hard: Whether someone can do the skill is seen in the room, not in the outline.
tasks.human_edge: She chooses the topic, teaches the session, and judges the skill. The outline does not teach.

ambition.what: Which approved paragraph this program is allowed to teach, before the session rather than after a slide is already wrong.

tasks.altitude: Teaching and the skill check stay the week. Outline time is shorter only when an approved paragraph already exists.

reach.task: Publish the paragraph id and the paragraph text the outline is allowed to quote.
reach.learn: If no approved paragraph exists, the nurse writes the outline and the saving does not apply.

evidence.claim: Thuisarts publishes guideline-based patient education texts from NHG, FMS and Patiëntenfederatie. A community outline may quote a paragraph from such a vetted public text. The nurse still signs the outline.
The inspectorate says providers are legally responsible for careful use of generative AI. The nurse checks that each outline point quotes an approved paragraph.
Ambient recording of staff can be a works-council matter under WOR art. 27(1)(l). The session is not recorded.

assumptions: Focal boundary: the nurse chooses the topic, drafts the outline, gives the session, judges the skill, and marks attendance. The clinical educator's writing of the protocol is outside this baseline.

Contract for the outline: paragraph id and paragraph text. For staff sessions the producer is the clinical educator who published the protocol. For a community session the producer is the editor of the public text the hospital has already approved. That approval is existing work, not this baseline.
If no approved paragraph exists, no outline is drafted, s2 stays at today's full time, and the saving does not apply.

Choosing the topic, giving the session, judging the skill, and marking attendance stay at full time. Attendance is her own mark, not a feed. The session is not recorded. Upkeep is the two hours below when a paragraph is revised.
unknowns: Which public text, if any, the hospital has already approved for community sessions.
Whether attendance is a paper slip or a name the educator expects in a learning record.
research_questions: What share of these programs have an approved paragraph the outline is allowed to quote?

already_counted.description: Judge whether people can do the skill.

incremental.description: Replace outline points when an approved paragraph is revised.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the outline draft is halved, and only when an approved paragraph already exists. Choosing the topic, giving the session, judging the skill and marking attendance stay at full time. Two hours of upkeep are already taken off. If paragraphs are missing, the result is near the low end.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still critical care at the bedside, plus conferences, protocol meetings and teaching. Less time goes to hunting a paper, a protocol paragraph or a problem line when those texts already exist. She still attends, still judges the wording, still holds the conference and still teaches. A draft does not publish a protocol or write a conference note.
reach: Clinical educator: publish the paragraph id and text before a protocol review or a teaching outline, and collect the hours slip the nurse still writes.
Protocol owner: the same publication duty when the owner is not the clinical educator. Without the paragraph, the nurse hunts the binder.
Treating clinician: enter the problem id and the problem line before a conference brief is shown. A missing line means she reads the chart.
skills_to_grow: Check that a paper card quotes the abstract and adds no claim.
Check that a protocol draft names the paragraph and adds no new clinical step.
role.ambitious_version: Each protocol comment names the paragraph it changes, and each conference starts from the problem line already on the record.
